calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cp.category, cp.subcategory, s.store_id
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter=1
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
ref AS (SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) refund_net, SUM(quantity_returned) q FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1)
SELECT sd.category, sd.subcategory, COUNT(*) lines, ROUND(SUM(sd.net_amount),2) sold_net, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0),2) refunded_net,
  ROUND(100.0*COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net),0)/SUM(sd.net_amount),2) rate
FROM sold sd LEFT JOIN ref r ON r.sales_line_id=sd.sales_line_id
WHERE sd.category IN ('Garden') OR sd.subcategory='Outdoor Lighting'
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT 'Q1 sold by sku-version mismatch: product_key valid vs sale_date' k, COUNT(*) v
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27' AND (f.sale_date < p.valid_from OR f.sale_date > p.valid_to)
UNION ALL SELECT 'Q1 sales lines with null/unknown product', COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dim_product p WHERE p.product_key=f.product_key)
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns where refund_net > sold net', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.refund_net > f.net_amount + 0.01
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns before sale', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE r.return_date < f.sale_date
UNION ALL SELECT 'returns of Q1 lines after 2025-07-27+30', COUNT(*) FROM fact_return_line r JOIN fact_sales_line f USING (sales_line_id) WHERE f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-04-28' AND DATE '2025-07-27' AND r.return_date > DATE '2025-08-26'

calls.statement:
WITH sold AS (
  SELECT f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, cp.subcategory
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku = p.sku AND cp.is_current
  JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
  WHERE d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_quarter = 1
    AND s.store_id <> 999 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test' AND cp.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    AND cp.category = 'Garden' AND cp.subcategory <> 'Outdoor Lighting'
),
refunds AS (
  SELECT sales_line_id, SUM(refund_net) AS refund_net FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT 'FY2025/26' AS fiscal_year, 1 AS fiscal_quarter, sd.subcategory,
       ROUND(SUM(sd.net_amount), 2) AS sold_net_eur,
       ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0), 2) AS returned_net_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(SUM(r.refund_net), 0) / SUM(sd.net_amount), 2) AS return_rate_pct
FROM sold sd LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.sales_line_id = sd.sales_line_id
GROUP BY sd.subcategory ORDER BY sd.subcategory
